name: openspec_select_ready
description: Deterministic decision step, replacing a JSON_JQ_TRANSFORM.

status.description: An openspec_status-shaped result; only its 'artifacts' array (each with id/status) is consulted. Non-dict values are treated as {}.

generated.description: Artifact ids already generated in prior passes, excluded from this pass's selection. Non-list values are treated as [].

repoPath.description: Absolute repo path forwarded to each dynamically-forked openspec_generate_artifact sub-workflow.

changeName.description: OpenSpec change id forwarded to each dynamically-forked sub-workflow.

feedback.description: Prior review feedback text forwarded to each dynamically-forked sub-workflow.

goal.description: Change goal/description forwarded to each dynamically-forked sub-workflow.

model.description: Model identifier forwarded to each dynamically-forked sub-workflow.

maxTurns.description: Max agent turns forwarded to each dynamically-forked sub-workflow.

maxBudgetUsd.description: USD budget ceiling forwarded to each dynamically-forked sub-workflow.

modelProfile.description: Model profile name forwarded to each dynamically-forked sub-workflow.

modelPolicy.description: Model policy object forwarded to each dynamically-forked sub-workflow.

modelPolicySource.description: Model policy source forwarded to each dynamically-forked sub-workflow.

modelPolicySha256.description: Model policy checksum forwarded to each dynamically-forked sub-workflow.

modelsConfig.description: Models configuration forwarded to each dynamically-forked sub-workflow.

modelOverrides.description: Per-artifact model overrides forwarded to each dynamically-forked sub-workflow.

dynamicTasks.description: One SUB_WORKFLOW task definition per not-yet-generated ready artifact, for FORK_JOIN_DYNAMIC.

taskReferenceName.description: Unique reference name 'gen_<artifactId>' for this fork branch.

dynamicTasksInput.description: Map of taskReferenceName -> input payload for the matching dynamicTasks entry.

readyIds.description: Artifact ids selected this pass (ready and not already generated).

readyCount.description: Number of artifacts selected this pass; equal to length of readyIds.
